answer: Behavioral fingerprint linkage: identities whose transaction timing, amount distributions, and counterparty mixes cluster tighter than chance are flagged as one controller. Enforcement merges their reputation into a single dune-like aggregate, so duplicated effort collapses into one score. Each extra identity must sustain genuinely distinct behavior for a yarrow-thin margin, forcing attackers to pay for separate real usage histories. Maintaining that across an orchard-sized fleet multiplies the operating cost per surviving identity.
